description: This file defines classes related to security scanning within the SuiteCRM project, including SugarSecure, ScanFileIncludes, and SugarSecureManager. It contains methods for scanning directories, reading file contents, and managing security scans.

classes.name: SugarSecure
classes.description: Class for scanning directories, storing results, displaying, and saving security scan results.

classes.name: ScanFileIncludes
classes.description: Subclass of SugarSecure that scans file contents for include and require statements.

classes.name: SugarSecureManager
classes.description: Manages multiple scanner instances, coordinating scans, display, and saving results.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs the scan results as an HTML table.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the scan results to a file.

methods.name: scan
methods.description: Recursively scans directories for PHP files.

methods.name: scanContents
methods.description: Analyzes file contents for include/require statements and other file operations.

methods.name: registerScan
methods.description: Registers a new scanner class with the manager.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays results from all registered scanners.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves results from all registered scanners to a timestamped file.
